app.open: Boilers lit. The network works are running, {addr}.
Shift started. Gauges checked, pipes watched.
all.good: Every gauge in the green. PC, Wi-Fi, internet.
pc.busy: The PC engine is overworked. CPU at {v}.
Pressure's high in the PC. The network pipes are fine.
Too many looms running. Shut one down.
wifi.drops: The Wi-Fi belt slipped {v} times today.
{v} drops. The signal pipe is leaking.
net.none: No line to the works. Connect the cable.
inet.slow: Your factory's fine. The railway past it is slow.
Home works quick. The provider's line is sluggish.
The holdup is beyond your router.
speedrunner: One lever at a time. The last job's still running.
back.again: Back on the floor. {v} things happened.
Welcome back. Here's the shift report.
dns.slow: The directory clerk is slow. DNS at {v}.
speed.bloat: Fast, but the pipes clog {v} under load.
Pressure backs up {v} when the line is full.
game.lag: The lag is the Wi-Fi belt, not the server.
The server runs true. Your Wi-Fi slips.
vpn.on: Traffic routed through a sealed pipe. VPN on.
portal: This mill wants your name at the gate. Sign in.
gw.down: The router stalled. Restart the engine.
No signal from the router. Check its lamps.
isp.down: Your works are fine. The supply line is cut.
Provider's line is down. Not your machinery.
mtu.small: Crates too big for the chute. MTU {v}.
mtr.lossy: Leak in the line from hop {v}.
mtr.clean: No leaks anywhere on the line.
award: 500 points. Foreman's medal: the Adeebo Award.
late.night: Night shift. The works keep running.
update.suspect: Running rough since the update on {v}.
The {v} update threw a spanner in.
call.on: A call is on. Keeping the line clear.
Call in progress. Watching the line.
game.streak: {v} in a row - line running smooth.
storm.near: Storm nearby - power and lines may trip.
stream.on: {v} runs on the line, steady as a flywheel.
stream.dip: A jolt on the stream belt. {v}
The stream line slipped a gear. {v}
trade.ok: The broker pipe runs at full pressure.
Broker line: gauges in the green.
trade.slow: Pressure's low to the broker. Hold the lever.
trade.closed: Market shift ended. Back on at 9:30.
The trading floor is shut till 9:30.
